target_profile.scope: Native Apple-silicon macOS binaries, including required public and Apple-specific extensions and ABI behavior; host extensions selected by explicit capability checks.
target_profile.inventory_limits: Reviewed shared A64 forms only. This list is not a complete Apple CPU feature contract, private-extension inventory, or binary-compatibility denominator.

instruction_sources.redistribution_scope: Only factual identifiers, names, categorical/feature metadata and fixed encoding bits are included. Arm XML, authored instruction prose and pseudocode remain local and are not redistributed.

profile.description: Uniform fixed SME2 guest execution profile with explicit SVL and initial SM/ZA state, separate from host capabilities. Logic requires streaming mode; length arithmetic admits all SM/ZA combinations. Every smoke sample declares its own SVL and SVCR.
outside_scope: Apple hardware conformance, applications and macOS boot
both MOVPRFX forms and logic as a successor of MOVPRFX
architectural FFR/FPMR access inferred from diagnostic preservation

forms.scope: Complete allocated standalone streaming Boolean, unary, selection, copy and cross-half form under fixed SME2 profile, all five supported SVLs. Source operands snapshot before writes; first element predicate bits govern merging/zeroing; aliases retain original values. Preserves unrelated primary state, predicates, SVCR/TPIDR2, ZA/ZT0, FPCR/FPSR/NZCV and RAM. Both MOVPRFX forms and execution as their successor are excluded; no paired-prefix claim. FFR/FPMR preservation is diagnostic only. Historical full-state original/model/native evidence transfers through fresh exact current-library body/maps, without semantic replay. Raw context leaf only; no block/cache, disabled-access traps, Apple hardware or application/macOS claim.
forms.review: Consolidated Boolean/copy mapping and isolated full-state original/model/native evidence; actual frozen-library full body/map preservation links the selected recipe to the context leaf.

Historical complete snapshot original/model/native comparisons transfer through fresh exact current-library body/maps without semantic replay. FFR diagnostic storage is not architectural-access credit. Raw context leaf only; no block/cache, disabled-access traps, Apple hardware or application/macOS claim.
